answer_2.quote: We report the precision (denoted as P ), recall (denoted as R), and F 1 score of the evaluation results.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 100 sentences and invite three experts to evaluate our decomposition results of these sentences. We still use precision and recall as evaluation metrics.
answer_4.guideline: Experts assess whether each event is correctly assigned to its time point, measuring precision and recall of the decomposition.
